setup.en: Use steady parallel bars with a step to get on and off. If you cannot yet lower yourself slowly, start with an assisted dip machine or with your feet supported. This asks a lot of the front of the shoulder; it is not a first exercise.
setup.zh: 用稳固的双杠，并准备一个上下用的台阶。还不能慢慢放低身体时，先用助力臂屈伸器械，或让脚有支撑。这个动作对肩前部要求很高，不适合作为入门的第一个动作。

steps.en: From the step, grip both bars with palms facing in and press up until your arms are straight and your weight is on your hands.
steps.zh: 站在台阶上双手握杠，掌心相对，撑起直到手臂伸直，体重落在手上。

steps.en: Lean your trunk slightly forward as one piece and bend your knees so your feet are behind you.
steps.zh: 整个躯干一起稍向前倾，屈膝让双脚在身后。

steps.en: Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower yourself slowly, elbows going back and a little out.
steps.zh: 吸气，屈肘慢慢放低身体，两肘向后、略向外。

steps.en: Stop at a comfortable depth, before the front of the shoulder feels strained; the upper arms need not go past level.
steps.zh: 在舒服的深度停下，在肩前部感到被拉紧之前；上臂不必低于水平。

steps.en: Breathe out and press down through the bars to straighten your arms, keeping the same lean.
steps.zh: 呼气，向下压杠把手臂撑直，保持同样的前倾。

steps.en: Put your feet back on the step before letting go of the bars.
steps.zh: 先把脚放回台阶上，再松开双杠。

cues.en: Press the bars down towards the floor.
Keep the forward lean small and steady.

mistakes.en: Dropping very deep. Why: the upper arm goes far behind the body and the front of the shoulder takes a large stretch under load.
mistakes.zh: 沉得很深。为什么：上臂被带到身体后方很远，肩前部在负重下被大幅拉伸。

mistakes.en: Swinging the legs to get out of the bottom. Why: the load jerks onto the shoulder.
mistakes.zh: 靠摆腿从最低点起来。为什么：负荷会猛地冲到肩上。

text.en: Use enough assistance to move slowly through a comfortable depth; reduce it in small steps.
text.zh: 借足够的助力，在舒服的深度里慢慢做；再一点点减少助力。

text.en: Spreading chest work over more than one day a week tends to work better than one big session.
text.zh: 把胸部训练分散到一周里不止一天，通常比一次练完效果好。

cautions.en: Stop at pain at the front of the shoulder, sharp chest pain or a tearing feeling.
cautions.zh: 肩前部疼痛、胸部刺痛或有撕裂感时停下。

cautions.en: Skip it, or use assistance, if you cannot hold the top position steadily.
cautions.zh: 在顶端还撑不稳时，先不做或用助力。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

text.en: Research shows: in 13 experienced men, upper-chest EMG was higher on the bars than with the hands on a bench behind the body, and highest on gymnastic rings.
text.zh: 研究显示：13 名有经验的男性，在双杠上做时上胸肌电高于手撑在身后凳子上做，吊环上最高。
